Lita.name: Lita
Lita.personality: Cheerful (you will always see her smiling!).
Lita.curiousFact: She has her own orchard and likes to encase herself in her shell, like a ball.

Duba.name: Duba
Duba.personality: Hungry (it's always a great time to eat!).
Duba.curiousFact: Her favorite dish is beefsteak and she loves to make "asados".

Yvoty.name: Yvoty
Yvoty.personality: Creative. Unprejudiced (she doesn't mind what people think!).
Yvoty.curiousFact: Yvoty means "flower" in the Guaraní language and is pronounced "ivotí", with the stress on the last "i". But it is written with two "y"!

Manic.name: Mañic
Manic.personality: Curious. Active. Agile (she never forgets her inline skates!).
Manic.curiousFact: Her grandmother from Formosa (Argentina) gave her the name, which literally means "ñandú" in the Qom language.

Capy.name: Capy y Guyrá
Capy.definition: the capybara and the cattle tyrant
Capy.curiousFact: Their names Capy (from "capybara" which means "lord of the grass") and Guyrá (means "bird"), are from the Tupi Guaraní language.

Chuy.name: Chuy
Chuy.personality: Generose. Sportsperson (they love to climb sea cliffs!).
Chuy.curiousFact: Their name comes from "chuy chuy" which means "cold" in the Mapuche language.

litaSalad.statement: Help Lita pick up the lettuce and the tomato and make the salad.

litaTomatoes.title: Lots of tomatoes
litaTomatoes.statement: Lita has to pick up all the tomatoes. Can you do it without repeating the same blocks over and over?

dubaSteak.title: Duba's steak
dubaSteak.statement: Take Duba to the steak and eat it.

dubaDetour.title: An obstacle on the way
dubaDetour.statement: There is an obstacle between Duba and the steak. Find a way around it.

chuyTrophy.title: Chuy's trophy
chuyTrophy.statement: Take Chuy to the trophy and pick it up.

chuyPingPong.title: Ping pong balls
chuyPingPong.statement: Chuy has to bounce every ping pong ball. Use repetition.

manicStar.title: A star for Manic
manicStar.statement: Take Manic to the star and observe it.

manicSky.title: Stargazing night
manicSky.statement: Manic wants to observe the star and then the planet.

capyCans.title: Cans on the shore
capyCans.statement: Capy has to pick up all the cans. Use repetition.

capyRecycle.title: Let's recycle
capyRecycle.statement: Help Capy pick up the can and the paper.

yvotyNight.title: Night in the jungle
yvotyNight.statement: Yvoty has to wake up the firefly and photograph the butterfly.

yvotyPhone.title: Yvoty's phone
yvotyPhone.statement: Take Yvoty to the phone and unlock it.

board.title: 1. Build the scene
board.text: Drag pieces from the palette onto the board, or tap a piece and then a cell. Drag across several cells to paint them at once.

texts.title: 2. Say what it is about
texts.text: Write the title and the statement above the board. Then choose the blocks the student will have and, if you like, the assessments.

try.title: 3. Try it and share it
try.text: Choose "Editor with preview" to play the challenge while you build it. When the publish checklist is complete, share it or download it.
